items: CurveType: Selects the curve interpolation method used by a Spline entity.
LinearPointWriter: Zero-allocation in-place Vec2 writer for continuous curve animation. Reuses existing Vec2 instances in the destination array to eliminate GC pressure.

buildAdaptiveQuadraticSpan: Helper to recursively subdivide a curve span into optimal quadratic bezier segments. Uses squared tolerance comparison and pushes [cpX, cpY, endX, endY] directly into outContour.
buildAdaptiveLinearSpan: Helper to recursively subdivide a continuous curve span directly into linear points [Vec2]. Measures perpendicular distance from midpoint to chord baseline.
buildSpanPoints: Builds linear points across a curve span using either adaptive or fixed mode.
